flagged.title: Disabled — Wilfred Owen
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly teaches that 'him' and 'hymn' are a near-rhyme/para-rhyme in 'Disabled', which is an inaccurate identification of poetic technique (they are homophones) that would lose marks under AO2.

mark_affecting.quote: First up, we have para-rhyme. This is the use of near-rhymes, like 'him' and 'hymn'... these jarring para-rhymes physically echo the soldier's broken, mismatched body
